name: Retribution

matches.stipulation: WSW European Championship (unifying into the new Pacific Northwest Championship)
matches.note: Dean King rolled through a reversed Diablo splash for the pin, becoming the first Pacific Northwest Champion.
Knuckles won the title with the Knuckledown superkick and a rollup.

Eros Fate (disguised as a second Kid Dynamic) and Demon II (disguised as Masahiro) helped stage a false finish; the real Masahiro then drove the real Kid Dynamic through a table, unmasking and injuring him. The broadcast's own commentary leaves the result unresolved.
Eros Fate pinned Darren Mack with Lock 'n' Loaded after a Synn-caused disqualification spot was waved off by the ring announcer's own call.

matches.stipulation: Cage Battle Royal for the last WSW Hardcore Championship
matches.note: A steel cage held a duffel bag with both of the promotion's Hardcore title belts; Nova Johnson reached it first to become the last Hardcore Champion.
Mr. Ed won with the Ed Slam after ducking a brass-knuckles shot, becoming the first Interstate Champion.
"Superstar" Sean Southward's interference backfired onto Donovan Astros; Krim'nal won with the Outtake.
Sean Southward retained with the Psycho Driver, a piledriver reversal of his own torture rack.

notes: The final card under the World Street Wrestling Federation name; several titles unify or rename on this broadcast.

matches.note: Matt Jethro won with the Deep Impact.
Matt Cossack won with Cossack's Thunder; Donovan Astros attacked Cossack after the bell.
GJP pinned Darren Mack with the Edge Factor for the New Age Outsiders' debut win.
Jason Reynolds won with Splash Mountain (the Sinister Edge).
Karnage won with a top-rope powerbomb.
Knuckles retained with the Omega Powerbomb.
"Kid Dynamic" won the title with a cobra clutch Russian legsweep, the "Truly Dynamic".
Donovan Astros won by disqualification after Matt Jethro ran in on his behalf.
Mr. Ed retained the Papercut pin after Dean King struck Nova Johnson with his own title belt and Kano/Dylan Quint brawled at ringside, distracting the referee.

Krim'nal won by disqualification after Donovan Astros interfered; the title cannot change hands on a disqualification, so Sean Southward remained champion. "Stunning" Steve Southward then turned on his brother with a Conchairto, joining Astros as the Hollywood Blondes.
Masahiro won the Mas-A-Man X-Factor with his feet on the ropes, out of the referee's sight.
Kendo Nakamura debuted with a win via a top-rope flipping legdrop.
"The Reason" Rick Carey won with the Aftermath (an Outsider's Edge off the top).
Diablo rolled through a flying bodypress and grabbed the tights for the pin.
Rukus The Luv Train won with a Northern Lights Suplex; the New Midnight Express then ran in on Ted Benet and revealed themselves as members of the stable 3GX alongside Rukus.
The Mutt won with the Impounder (a Tilt-a-Whirl Slam).
Nova Johnson pinned Dean King with the Novabomb; backstage before the match, Nova Johnson had handed his last Hardcore Championship belt to Kano.
No bell was rung: the New Age Outsiders ambushed the champions before introductions, and Rukus The Luv Train unmasked Triple M as the returning Lone Wolf.
Karnage won a number-one-contendership match by grabbing the tights on the pin.
Matt Jethro pinned Donovan Astros after Sean Southward, disguised as a fan, chairshotted Astros from the crowd.
Rune won with a brainbuster.
Kendo Nakamura won a Light Heavyweight number-one-contendership match with a top-rope legdrop.
"The Reason" Rick Carey caned all four men before the bell could ring, and the match never started; the broadcast's own text records no result.

matches.stipulation: Royal Rumble (number-one contendership for the WSW Championship)

eliminations.note: Rukus ran in on Diablo from outside the ring and was thrown out almost immediately.

matches.note: Twenty numbers were drawn; two entrants (DeJa Sku, Ice Dogg) never appeared. "The Reason" Rick Carey won last, eliminating Krim'nal with help from Kristen Jean's Singapore Cane.

name: WSW Wednesday Night, July 3, 2002

matches.note: Diablo won by disqualification after Krim'nal brought a chair into the match and piledrove Diablo on it.
Kano won the title with the Armageddon powerbomb.
Kendo Nakamura won with a top-rope guillotine legdrop.
Jason Reynolds won the title with the Sinister Edge.
The New Age Outsiders won by forfeit after Brock Landerz's partner Tyreek Taylor failed to appear, then attacked Landerz after the bell; the WSW Tag Team Champions ran in to make the save.
Rukus The Luv Train won the title by submission with the Luv Struck (Rings of Saturn).

"The Reason" Rick Carey won with a rollup, then caned Nova Johnson after the bell; Sean Southward made the save before the Hollywood Blondes ambushed him, and Krim'nal ran in with a lead pipe to clear the ring.

notes: Broadcast on the eve of Summer Showdown; three titles change hands.

matches.note: Paul Doom debuted with a win via the Doom Death Drop, a release powerbomb.
Rune won when Matt Cossack ran in and chairshotted Astros as Astros held Rune in the Astrolock with the referee knocked out.
Sean Southward retained by making his brother Steve submit to the Sharpshooter.

name: WSW Summer Showdown

matches.note: Two unnamed men attacked Rukus The Luv Train at ringside, taking him out of the match; the New Midnight Express retained when Eros Fate pinned GJP with Kingdom Come.
Both men's shoulders were pinned for a three count at the same moment; the referee ruled a draw, and Knuckles retained the title.
Donovan Astros won with the Shockwave (a Vertebreaker).
The Mutt won with a second Impounder.
Mr. Chumleywarner won the title by forcing a submission with an ankle lock.
Kano retained with the Armageddon powerbomb at 13:27.
Jason Reynolds retained with a release powerbomb.
Sean Southward retained by pinning Rick Carey after both men connected with a chair and a Singapore Cane at the same moment.

notes: No bell ever rang for a scheduled Paul Doom vs. Rick Carey interview segment: Carey ambushed Doom instead, driving him through a table and handcuffing him to the ropes for a prolonged beating. Steve Southward's scheduled challenge for Krim'nal was called off backstage after Krim'nal failed to appear; James J. Tunney announced the Lord of the Ring tournament in its place.

name: WSW Superstars, July 20, 2002

matches.stipulation: Lord of the Ring, first round
matches.note: Alternativ won with the Jackel's Edge.
The Destruction Constructors won their debut with the tandem Blueprints of Destruction.
Evan Sky won with the Shocker.

matches.stipulation: Lord of the Ring, first round
matches.note: Jason Reynolds won with the Sinister Edge.
Points of Authority won a short-handed six-man tag after Alternativ interfered on their behalf, chairshotting Triple M for the Monkey Wrench submission.

notes: No bell rang for an announced Matt Jethro/Kendo Nakamura tag match: Jethro's own mystery partner turned out to be Nakamura, whom Jethro then betrayed and beat down alongside Kano, Matt Cossack and Jason Reynolds, the four declaring themselves the stable the Untouchables.

matches.note: Rukus The Luv Train's protege Rave X debuted with a win via "A Hit of Ecstasy".
Kano retained with a turnbuckle powerbomb at 13:56.

matches.stipulation: Lord of the Ring, first round
matches.note: "Electric" Evan Sky won with the Shocker.
Derek Craven won his debut with a tights-assisted cradle; Kid Dynamic attacked him with the Truly Dynamic after the bell.

matches.stipulation: Lord of the Ring, first round
matches.note: Donovan Astros won with a low blow and the Astrocide.

Rukus The Luv Train, billed by this broadcast as champion without any aired win back from Mr. Chumleywarner (who had beaten him for the title eleven days earlier at Summer Showdown), retained with the Luv Struck.
Sean Southward retained with the Shining Wizard after interference from Diablo and Nova Johnson both failed.

name: WSW Superstars, August 10, 2002

matches.stipulation: Lord of the Ring, first round
matches.note: Rukus The Luv Train won with the Luv Struck after Mr. Chumleywarner ran in and hit The Mutt with the Last Resort.
The Destruction Constructors won with a huracarana off Maverick's shoulders.

matches.stipulation: Lord of the Ring, first round
matches.note: Matt Jethro won with the Deep Impact.
Referee Ryan Stevens first awarded Derek Craven the title after a lead-pipe shot, then reversed the decision on Josh Milton's word, awarding Jason Reynolds the match and title by disqualification.

notes: No bell rang for an announced Spectre match: Sean Southward ambushed The Spectre with a chair before any opponent was introduced; Donovan Astros then turned on Southward with the Astrocide before attacking Spectre as well.

name: WSW Superstars, August 17, 2002

matches.note: "Invincible" Lance Adams won his debut with a tombstone piledriver.
A non-title match: Jason Reynolds won by disqualification after Derek Craven ran in and hit him with his own Pacific Northwest title belt.

matches.stipulation: Lord of the Ring, first round
matches.note: Referee Cherry Mirage stopped the match on a cross-arm breaker, ruling Kid Dynamic unable to continue.

matches.stipulation: Lord of the Ring, first round
matches.note: Mr. Chumleywarner won with the Last Resort; Kristen Jean's interference on his behalf failed when Rick Carey accidentally knocked her from the apron.

An unidentified attacker cut the arena lights and struck down the winning Spectre with a chair, leaving a note on his chest; Donovan Astros then covered him for the pin and left with the note, torn up and unread by the broadcast's own end.

notes: The last surviving broadcast of the promotion's 2002 run; the main event closes on an unresolved mystery attack. No bell rang for an announced New Age Outsiders/New Midnight Express Tag Team title match: the Destruction Constructors attacked the New Age Outsiders backstage, then ambushed the New Midnight Express in the ring as well, and challenged them for the Tag Team Championship at the September 15 Lord of the Ring.
